title: Find the Repeated Letter
statement:
You are given a string `s` of lowercase English letters in which at least one letter appears two or more times.

For every letter that repeats, look at the position of its **second** occurrence. Print the letter whose second occurrence comes **earliest** in the string, that is, the first letter you would notice is a repeat if you read `s` from left to right.

If exactly one letter appears twice and every other letter appears once, this is simply the letter that appears twice.
inputFormat: A single line containing the string `s`.
constraints: At least one letter appears at least twice in `s`

examples.explanation: Reading left to right, the first time we see a letter we have already seen is at index 4 (the second "b"). The second "a" only comes at index 5, so the answer is "b".
The second occurrences are at index 2 for "a", index 4 for "b" and index 5 for "z". The earliest is "a".
"l" is the only repeated letter, and its second occurrence is at index 3.

hints: Scan from left to right and remember which letters you have already met.
The first letter you meet that is already in your memory is the answer; you can stop right there.
